limitations: Ten invocations per method; same controlled prior/25 public frames/20 fit +5 holdout. Alternating method order.
Single shared host i7-9750H/GTX1660Ti6GiB; unrelated user CPU work remains active. No latency guarantee or statistical confidence.
Absent CuPy disk cache chosen before process startup; first fresh-file invocation includes CUDA/NVRTC initialization. No separate warmup.
Full snapshot verification/loading/capture 2.796825199970s included exactly once across ten trials.
External files deliberately are not reverified in snapshot estimates; problem digest is checked every invocation; all backends are newly prepared.
Repeated timings are not independent recovery trials. Convergence/parity do not establish accuracy; covariance/observability unknown.

protocol.failure_policy: Preserve failed/partial trials and available standard results; never replace an unavailable candidate with CPU output.
protocol.initial_estimate_policy: Controlled demo initialization: dataset reference plus fixed local Euler offsets. Rotation deg xyz=(0.5, 0.0, 0.0); camera-frame translation m xyz=(0.5, 0.0, 0.0). This is not an independently measured prior.
protocol.split_policy: 25 numeric-ordered, uniformly selected provider positions; every fifth frame is holdout (20 fit / 5 holdout), fixed before optimization.
protocol.tuning_policy: Same solver settings for both backends; no holdout tuning.
